en.headline: Food Expo and concurrent fairs open at Convention Centre from 13 August
en.dek: The HKTDC event runs five days with more than 1,850 exhibitors from over 30 countries and regions; public tickets start from HK$30 and cover multiple concurrent shows.
body: The 36th HKTDC Food Expo will open at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai from Thursday 13 August to Monday 17 August, running alongside the Home Delights Expo, Beauty and Wellness Expo and the Hong Kong International Tea Fair.

According to the Trade Development Council, more than 1,850 exhibitors from over 30 countries and regions will take part under the theme Live Well, Stay Well. The Food Expo introduces a new desserts and gelato theme zone this year, while the concurrent trade-oriented Food Expo Pro and Tea Fair run from 13 to 15 August.

Public opening hours are 10am to 10pm from 13 to 16 August and 10am to 6pm on 17 August. Admission to the public halls starts at HK$30; children aged three or below and seniors aged 65 or above enter free. The organisers said entry closes 45 minutes before daily closing time.

zh.headline: 美食博覽8月13日起會展開鑼 一票行勻多展
zh.dek: 貿發局主辦的第36屆美食博覽及同期展覽於灣仔會展舉行，超過1,850家展商參展，公眾館門票30元起。
body: 第36屆香港貿發局美食博覽將於8月13日（星期四）至17日（星期一）在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行，同期設有家電‧家居‧博覽、美與健生活博覽及香港國際茶展。
貿發局表示，來自逾30個國家及地區超過1,850家展商參與，主題為「Live Well．Stay Well」。美食博覽今年新增甜品及義式雪糕主題區，商貿性質的美食商貿博覽及茶展則於13至15日舉行。
公眾開放時間為8月13至16日上午10時至晚上10時，17日上午10時至下午6時。公眾館門票30元起，3歲或以下小童及65歲或以上長者免費入場，每日關閉前45分鐘停止進場。
